title: ZenPath — telemetry-driven navigation simplification and rollout lenses
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: the current console sidebar and workspace routing surface too many static entries for teams with mixed workloads, leading to cluttered navigation, unclear pathing for rollouts, and inconsistent exposure of cost lenses. Goals: design a telemetry-informed simplification layer (ZenPath) that progressively surfaces routes, consolidates low-value items into contextual drawers, and provides per-team rollout lenses for safe A/B routing during deploys. Deliverables: high-fidelity prototype, acceptance criteria, rollout lens patterns, and handoff spec for Eng and PM. Constraints: must support multi-workspace tenants, preserve deep-linking and keyboard navigation, and be implementable without backend schema changes for initial canary.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates automatic promotion/demotion of sidebar items based on telemetry buckets
Canary rollout lens UI allows PMs to bind a route to 3 rollout cohorts and preview routing fallback behavior
Collapsed contextual drawer can be expanded by keyboard focus and preserved per-user preference
Design doc includes accessibility checklist (keyboard, screen reader labels, focus order) and token-level cost visibility hook
Handoff includes annotated Figma frames, component spec, and sample telemetry payloads for ENG to implement mock routing
design_notes: ZenPath is a layered IA: Primary (top 6 dynamic routes), Contextual Drawer (low-frequency entries), and Rollout Lens bar (sticky top of workspace)
Telemetry inputs: daily active clicks, error/500 frequency on route, average latency impact, and cost-per-token exposure. Use a weighted score to surface top routes per workspace.
Progressive disclosure: show micro-summaries for collapsed drawers (recent 3 items with timestamps), full list on expand
Routing affordances: explicit visual badge when a route is under a rollout lens; hover reveals cohort exposure percent and fallback model
Preference persist: per-user cookie+account setting; default derived from workspace-wide telemetry but editable by power users
Edge cases: private deployments with limited telemetry must allow manual pinning of routes; provide an admin override panel in Dedicated/Private builds

decisions: Adopt a telemetry-weighted scoring model (clicks*0.5 + recent_sessions*0.3 + error_penalty*1.0 + cost_impact*0.2) for ranking routes
Primary list capped at 6 items to optimize for cognitive load across tenants
Rollout Lens will be visible only for routes with active rollouts and have an inline cohort inspector
Private/Dedicated deployments will default to manual pinning UI if telemetry is unavailable
mock_review_feedback: PM: Need explicit fallback explanation when a cohort experiences a model regression
Eng: Provide sample telemetry payloads and a mock routing middleware for initial canary
Accessibility reviewer: Ensure focus trap is not used for drawer; use roving focus instead
